title: A Humble Beginning with Big Intent
description: Started as Ami Organics, laying the foundation for a journey driven by science and purpose.

title: Safety First from Day One
description: Earned the Gujarat Gas Safety Award for building a strong and responsible HSE culture early on.

title: Raising Standards in Governance
description: Implemented Integrated Management System and secured SA 8001 certification for accountability.

title: Global Vision Takes Shape
description: Crossed INR 1,000 mn in revenue, marking growth and international expansion.

title: First USFDA Milestone Achieved
description: Passed the first USFDA inspection and gained DSIR approval for in-house R&D excellence.

title: Capacity Boost and Global Recognition
description: Achieved INR 1,500 mn turnover and won key prestigious export performance awards.

title: Expanding Capacities, Gaining Spotlight
description: Recognised as a Two Star Export House with SAP’s Innovation Award and a GMP compliant facility commissioned at Sachin.

title: Safety Systems Redefined
description: Earned ISO 45001:2018 certification, reinforcing commitment to a safe and resilient workplace.

title: Investing in Research and Recovery
description: Commissioned a new R&D lab with another EIR from USFDA for Sachin, Surat Site.

title: A Breakout Year of Expansion and Trust
description: Acquired Ankleshwar and Jhagadia units, filed new patents, won national awards, and got listed on BSE and NSE.

title: Foray into Battery Chemicals
description: Indigenously Developed Electrolyte addtives used in batteries for EVs and Energy storage systems.

title: Foray Into Sustainable Growth
description: Acquired 55% stake in Baba Fine Chemicals and earned ECOVADIS Bronze for ESG commitment.

title: Sustainability Recognised at the Top
description: Achieved ECOVADIS Gold rating, validating ACUTAAS’ leadership in environment and governance practices.

title: Rebranding, Compliance and Expansion
description: Rebranded as Acutaas Chemicals, secured PMDA GMP for Ankleshwar, and formed Indichem Inc. with South Korea’s J & Materials for semiconductor chemicals.
